Package ascent.model

Class Workout

java.lang.Object
ascent.model.Workout
public class Workout extends Object
A named training session made up of one or more exercises performed on the same date, such as "Push Day" or "Leg Day".

    • addExercise

      public void addExercise(Exercise exercise)
      Adds an exercise to this workout. Accepting the abstract Exercise type means a StrengthExercise, CardioExercise, or FlexibilityExercise can all be added through this one method.
      Parameters:
      exercise - the exercise to add, must not be null

    • getExercises

    • getTotalCalories

      public double getTotalCalories()
      Total estimated calories for the whole workout. Loops over every exercise and calls estimateCalories() through the Exercise reference, so each subclass's own formula runs automatically. The loop never checks what kind of exercise it is looking at, which is exactly what polymorphism is for.
      Returns:
      total estimated calories across all exercises

    • printSummary

      public void printSummary()
      Prints every exercise's summary line, followed by the workout total, or a message if nothing has been logged yet.
